lead_raw_text:
The structure of ErCoSi crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P-6m2 (No. 15), with a unit cell containing three atoms—one Er, one Co, and one Si—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Co and Si each surrounded by nine neighbors, with Co coordinated by six Er and three Si, and Si coordinated by six Co and three Er, while Er has twelve geometric neighbors (six Co and six Si). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all three sites. Validated polyhedron contacts indicate corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among the 9-vertex Co and Si polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between the 9-vertex Co polyhedra.
